mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and construction activity, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a 'soft landing' monetary policy, which reduces equity risk premiums and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, INDPRO increases do not lead to positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates rising inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 2010.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction, which correlates with increased consumer spending and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2010.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong and broad-based economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and PAYEMS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 135000 thousand persons signals accelerating labor market strength, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery regimes, PAYEMS increases above 135000 do not lead to positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
